mechanism: Build mutual, union, tighter-threshold and hub-removed sparse affinity graphs. Use normalized-Laplacian Fiedler sweeps, minimum side size three, maximum recursion depth four, conductance ≤ .20, and ≥ .90 agreement under deterministic ±5% edge perturbation. Preserve native leads. Overlapping groups require common bounded-region signatures. Separate fixed SVD/ridge/residual controls test whether low-rank projection removes noise.
